_comment: Human-curated causal layer. Every edge needs rationale+source. Metric numbers are NOT stored here (parsed from files by build.py); ACCEPTED_BECAUSE edges cite the metric id that build.py creates. JSON format = YAML-compatible subset, stdlib-only parsing.

hypotheses.label: Blind invariance (L_inv all tokens) improves OOD transfer
Asymmetric inv (inv_head MLP, BYOL-style) fixes rank collapse AND OOD
Unsupervised calibration readout (P1u_s2 + Otsu) is the deployable default
Nonlinear probe (MLP) on calibrated features unlocks transfer
Selective inv on sound-metal tokens only (oracle mask Stage 0) preserves class signal

failures.label: Blind-inv washout: aligning defect-coupled tokens across conditions destroys class signal (over-invariance)
Train-scan telemetry optimism: pre-fix telemetry measured TRAIN scans, not the 4 canonical val files
Probe sign/direction rotates per condition: supervised directions that work on Hall fail on TMR
P2 is a polarity mirror (1-P0 on hard files), not a learned TMR defect direction
Mahalanobis readout is constant 0.667+-0.003 across 4 runs: uninformative for model selection
L_inv amplitude-shrinkage hijack: direct inv collapses defect norm (10->1.4D rank) unless delayed/weakened

invariants.label: Hardware offsets via unsupervised spatial self-calibration; no cross-sensor penalties (GEMINI.md s4)
Pure SSL: no waveform/sensor metadata injection (GEMINI.md s3)
Check-before-proposing: consult registry/graph before new directions (GEMINI.md s2)
Causal chain required: Code/Math -> Optimization -> Latent geometry -> Downstream (GEMINI.md s5)
Zero metric recycling: claims about a checkpoint need that checkpoint's own measurements (GEMINI.md s5)

readouts.label: P0 LR on raw scattering (legacy baseline)
P1u_s2 LR: unsupervised bg stats + shrinkage s2 (deploy default)
Otsu threshold replacing fixed 0.5 for IoU
P3 supervised (best on exp51 only, not transferable)
Official MLP probe on raw features (sanity anchor)

exp49_inv_xcov_20261014_021809.verdict: Delayed-inv curriculum (inv ep11+ramp20, w=0.5); best ckpt effectively pre-inv. Best OOD 0.554/0.037 (P0) and 0.556/0.055 (P1u_s2). Bar for all inv runs.

exp49_inv_xcov_20261014_135025.verdict: Diverged inv run (0.827 train optimism, test 0.554 P0-equivalent 0.661 maha). Evidence for FM6.

exp51_asyminv_20261015_013636.verdict: Engineering win (rank 8-8.7 held, val 0.88, zero guard trips) but OOD fail: all 9 OOD cells degraded vs 021809. Kills H1, halves H2.

exp52_waveforminv_tokenizer_20261015_130.verdict: Easy alignment (inv->0.0004) but rank 11->31D noise dims, honest val 0.625 vs telemetry 0.935 (FM2 exhibit), test 0.477. Kills H3.

exp53_energyadaptive_tokenizer_20261015_.verdict: Best overall OOD to date: test LP 0.5630/0.0379 (P0), P1u_s2 0.5669/0.0423, MLPraw 0.5732. Driven by TMR rescue (suiteLP 0.486->0.554, P1u_s2 0.387->0.521) while conceding Hall (Air 0.594->0.558, Pot 0.611->0.581). Caveat: confounded (tokenizer + dropped offset/pool-var guards); whitening HURTS TMR here (P1 0.428 < P0 0.554).

exp54_selective_oracle_20261015_223926.verdict: Stage-0 oracle FAILS the >=0.55 bar: test LP 0.4929/0.0247 (P0), P1u_s2 0.4948; best probe P3 0.5301 still below bar. Rank healthy (7.3D) but pred_loss rose 1.07->1.77 and masked inv stuck at 0.69. Washout is deeper than the mask.

edges.rationale: No-inv control arm of the inv dose-response series (6 runs: weaker/later inv only delays rank collapse 10->1.4D).
100ep asymmetric inv: rank held yet every OOD cell below 021809.
inv_head MLP BYOL-style; rank fix yes, OOD fix no.
waveform_invariant tokenizer arm, 34ep.
Oracle GT sound-mask inv, upper-bound ablation (supervised leak by construction).
Single-variable mirror of 021809 with energy_adaptive tokenizer.
Dose-response over 4 direct-inv runs + exp51: weaker/later inv only delays collapse, never prevents; exp51 degrades all 9 OOD cells.
inv loss ->0.0004 (trivially aligned) while honest val 0.625 / test 0.477: alignment without class signal.
MLPp1u_s2 0.544 < LR-P1u_s2 0.556 on 021809; TMR dead (0.41-0.43) for LR and MLP alike: wrong direction, not missing capacity.
Partial: asym-inv holds rank 8-8.7 and val 0.88 with zero guard trips (fixes collapse), but not OOD.
P1u_s2 reproduces supervised P1_s2 without GT (021809: 0.556/0.055); Otsu recovers ~60% of oracle IoU headroom.

Caveat accept: exp53 test LP 0.5630 > 021809 0.5543, driven by TMR rescue (suiteLP 0.486->0.554; P1u_s2 0.387->0.521) at the cost of Hall Air/Pot (0.594->0.558, 0.611->0.581). Confounded by dropped offset/pool-var guards: needs clean single-variable ablation.

Stage-0 oracle misses the >=0.55 bar: test LP 0.4929 (P0), P1u_s2 0.4948, best probe P3 0.5301. Pred_loss rose 1.07->1.77 while masked inv stuck at 0.69: washout is deeper than the sound/defect mask split.

Best single probe on exp53 (MLPraw 0.5732 > LR-P1u_s2 0.5669 same ckpt) but TMR stays weak (MLPraw 0.551, MLPp1u_s2 0.466): probe capacity helps only once feature direction is right; it cannot rescue wrong-direction features. Consistent with H5.
corr(P0,P2)=-0.77 exp51 / -0.38 021809: P2 inverts P0, accidentally right on TMR (0.58) where P0 is already wrong (0.38).
Test maha 0.667+-0.003 across 4 runs: no selection power.
Same as H5: nonlinear probe cannot rescue wrong per-condition direction.
L_inv over all 16 context tokens incl. defect-coupled pixels.
Direct encoder pull shrinks defect norm; exp49-old post-mortem.

Asymmetric route: encoder never directly pulled; rank collapse cured (not OOD).
Stage-0 hypothesis: align sound tokens only; verdict pending exp54.
Default readout going forward: +50% AP, +0.01 AUC, 100% unsupervised calibration.
Replaces fixed 0.5 threshold for IoU eval.
Blind cross-condition penalty corrupts the pretraining manifold instead of unsupervised self-calibration.
